messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: service=inference-service image=v2.1.0 -> targets: 5% -> 15% -> 30%. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.1.0
lia: pushing now. main change is tokenizer fix and some perf tweaks. will monitor token-parse-errors and 95p latency.
marta: picked up a small elevation in token-parse-errors in apac during the 5% ramp (+0.11% absolute). pulling samples. :mag:
omar: 50/95 latency looks steady. is the error tied to a particular tokenizer config?
marta: logs show tokenizer_config=alternate for a subset of APAC nodes. probable config drift in the APAC build pipeline. sample error: `unexpected_token at prompt_id=8721`
jen: recommend we pause progression in APAC and pin region to v2.0.9 to prevent customer impact. EU and US can continue.
lia: agree. request a regional pin on APAC and hold the 15% step.
jen: command: `/deploy pin --service inference-service --region apac --version 2.0.9`
deploy-bot: Executing pin: service=inference-service region=apac -> pinned to 2.0.9. APAC traffic: 0% v2.1.0. Canary paused for APAC. (job=db-49402)
sam: I'll add a short customer-facing note for APAC testers and update release notes to mention the pin.
omar: starting a rebuild of APAC image with corrected tokenizer config. ETA ~10m. will run smoke tests against failing prompt set when ready.
marta: reproducer: `curl -H "X-Region: apac" https://staging-infer/api/parse -d "prefix=<<long-prefix>>"` -> returns `unexpected_token`. I'll run smoke once build done and report metrics.
deploy-bot: Build queued: build-7790. Will post smoke results here.
lia: can we extend change window by 20m? current window ends 04:00 UTC.
jen: extending change window +20m to 04:20 UTC. logged.
omar: rebuild finished, smoke tests green on failing set. uploading artifact v2.1.0-cfgfix.
deploy-bot: Artifact v2.1.0-cfgfix ready. Ready to unpin and soft-canary in APAC? React :shipit: to proceed.
jen: :shipit: from oncall. proceed with APAC soft-canary 5%.
lia: unpin + rollout 5% APAC now, monitoring token-parse-errors and edge-errors for 30m.
deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted: APAC -> 5% v2.1.0-cfgfix, 95% pinned 2.0.9. Canary flag active.
marta: 20m in, metrics look normal. token-parse-errors returned to baseline, no new client failures in sample set.
lia: hold until full 30m completes then we'll consider resuming broader progression. thanks team. :thumbsup:
